description: Periodic measurements of air emissions from stationary sources are carried out in the regulated area.

blocks.text: Periodic measurements of air emissions from stationary sources are carried out in the regulated area.

items: Analysis of gases and dust: We test, among others, oxides, a wide range of heavy metals, VOCs, TVOC and specific chemical compounds (hydrogen chloride, ammonia, formaldehyde).
Gas parameters: Precise measurements of gas volume flow (backpressure method, anemometric method, thermo-anemometric method) and concentration of oxygen and water vapour.
Noise emissions from installations: We determine the sound power level of machinery, equipment and entire industrial plants (using direct measurement and calculation methods).

blocks.text: We use state-of-the-art analytical techniques to test for harmful factors in the working and natural environment:

items: Advanced laboratory techniques: We perform sample analysis using, among others, spectrometry and chromatography.
Indoor air quality: Measurement of concentrations of substances harmful to health in rooms intended for human occupancy.

Water and wastewater management: We take samples (single, composite, 24-hour) and analyse wastewater, groundwater, rainwater and surface water using potentiometric, conductometric, gravimetric and titrimetric methods.

blocks.text: Guarantee of measurement precision and support for authorities

The scope of services provided by the accredited Calibration Laboratory includes the calibration of multi-gas analysers, gas concentration metres, flue gas analysers, and total organic carbon (TOC) analysers with FID detectors.

We organise specialist seminars for staff from administrative units on issues relating to the burning of waste in heating furnaces (the training can take place at our company’s premises or at a location chosen by the client).
